entries.name: CB — 40 CEPT channels
entries.notes: 4 W AM and FM, 12 W PEP SSB. Channel 9 (27.065 MHz) is the emergency channel and channel 19 the road channel.

entries.name: Wireless M-Bus and assistive listening — 169 MHz
entries.notes: Long-range utility metering, and hearing-aid assistive listening.

entries.name: TETRA — public safety
entries.notes: Digital trunked radio for police, fire and ambulance: π/4-DQPSK in 25 kHz carriers. Encrypted end to end, so only the presence of a carrier is visible.

entries.name: PMR446 — licence-exempt
entries.notes: 16 analogue FM channels at 0.5 W ERP, no licence anywhere in CEPT. dPMR and DMR digital channels share the same 200 kHz.

entries.name: SRD — 868 MHz
entries.notes: ERC/REC 70-03. LoRaWAN, wireless M-Bus, alarms and sensors, all duty-cycle limited. Europe's answer to Region 2's 915 MHz.

entries.name: Road tolling — DSRC
entries.notes: CEN DSRC beacons at motorway gantries.
